title: Kronsh
extract:
The Kronsh is an  Impact-focused Strike used in Zaw construction.

Acquisition
The Kronsh blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for  1,000.

Characteristics
This Strike primarily deals  Impact damage.

70%  Impact
30%  Slash
Compatible weapon types:

Machete
Polearm
